purpose: Read-only visual triage of source groups 01–03 before production repair/generation
identity_invariants: Orange fluffy 3D cartoon office fox, large white-tipped tail
Round black glasses, white shirt, navy tie, black trousers and shoes
Preserve proportions, glasses size, muzzle, ears, eye color and fur from clean existing pose reference
Employee badge and watch should be consistent with chosen clean reference; the source sheets omit or vary these details
Fixed camera and constant lighting for each sequence; chair movement is object/character rotation, not camera rotation

groups.advantages: Large enough to identify all poses clearly; source grid aligns with its intended poses
limitations: Opaque dark blue background with white grid lines
Each sprite about 200–240 pixels high; not enough native resolution for 760px full-body video use
Body size and chair proportions vary slightly across cells
No timing/FPS supplied; sequence is a chain of distinct actions rather than one loop

intended_actions.source_description: First approximately 15 cells: seated front → right profile → rear → left profile → front
intended_actions.playback: Can become a loop only after a matching first/last pose and stable chair-foot pivot are established

intended_actions.source_description: Remaining cells: forward lean from seat, push off armrests, hips rise, stand beside/in front of same chair
intended_actions.playback: One-shot with final standing pose held; keep chair in the frame

intended_actions.source_description: Final two cells: standing fox opens one hand outward
intended_actions.playback: Insufficient intermediate poses for smooth standalone animation

groups.visual_layout: Approximately 17 characters across each of 8 visual rows; existing pack incorrectly uses 16 × 8 crops
groups.numeric_screening: First-row dark-foot pixels resolve into 17 nearby x-clusters after merging split shoes; not 16 equal cells
limitations: Sprites roughly 70–120 pixels high on an opaque tan gradient
Several actions and framing scales mixed in one sheet
Bust row cannot be combined with full-body row as one animation
Different head/tail visibility is actual perspective change, not facial animation
intended_actions_by_visual_row: Standing full-body turn front → side → back → side → front
Standing → lean forward → sit down on black wheeled office chair
Seated chair turn front → right profile → back → left profile → front
Seated reverse turn back → side → front
Forward lean and rise from chair to standing
Bust/head turn with rear views; not a lip-sync set
Rear/tail/body turn, cropped above head in places

groups.visual_layout: 9 visual rows with unequal spacing, prop widths and group lengths; no uniform rectangular grid can correctly extract every sprite
limitations: Most figures only approximately 70–115 pixels high
Full body, bust, props and desk compositions mixed on opaque tan background
Generic board charts are illustration props, not factual data visualizations
The empty frame_039.png is not a reliably identified missing animation frame because the underlying equal-grid extraction is wrong
intended_actions_by_visual_row: Idle narrator full body, subtle turn and blink
Presenting examples with bar/line/pie/checklist boards and some plain standing variants
Standing turn, cheer jump, wave/present gestures
Holding laptop/typing and headset conversational poses
Desk typing from multiple viewing angles, lean/relax variants

recommended_generation_priority.reason: Largest new capability requested by the supplied sheets; no existing high-quality clean production sequence
recommended_generation_priority.requirements: Same black wheeled office chair in all views, same ground pivot, constant character height, front/right/rear/left/front; frames in row-major order with no labels

recommended_generation_priority.reason: One-shot transition needed between standing narrator and seated scenes
recommended_generation_priority.requirements: Chair present from first frame and stationary; fox feet maintain ground plane, bends hips/knees, contacts seat smoothly; hold seated final pose

recommended_generation_priority.reason: Completes seated→standing storytelling and hook transition
recommended_generation_priority.requirements: Same chair as sit_down; forward lean, weight transfer to feet, rise, settle; no disappearing chair; hold standing final pose

recommended_generation_priority.reason: Actual articulated full-body movement beyond swapping static poses
recommended_generation_priority.requirements: In-place walk cycle at fixed three-quarter view, distinct foot contact/passing poses, alternating arms, consistent tail, first and last phases match without a duplicated pause

recommended_generation_priority.reason: Reusable channel greeting, existing tiny 6-frame source is not full-resolution production material
recommended_generation_priority.requirements: Fixed feet and body scale, smooth hand raise and wave, no body morphing, return to starting arm pose

recommended_generation_priority.reason: Stable holding shot to join one-shot actions without repeated cuts
recommended_generation_priority.requirements: Feet/tail locked, very small breathing and one natural blink; no mouth lip-sync inference

recommended_generation_priority.reason: Common production narration action without embedding a misleading generic chart
recommended_generation_priority.requirements: One explicit pointing/open-hand action; keep other arm, face, stance and camera consistent; no built-in chart or text

handoff_constraints: Do not relabel 458 old source cells as 458 production frames
Do not invent FPS or claim smooth animation merely from sorted PNG names
New images must be generated/edited with imagegen and saved inside the workspace
Verify actual alpha, complete body silhouette and clips on both light and dark backgrounds
Keep raw archive, existing working poses and original assets/mascot unchanged
